items.text: Distinguish order accepted, working, partial fill, cancelled, rejected, missed, timed out and unknown outcome; never synthesize missing fills.
evidence: The append-only order journal now distinguishes CREATED, SUBMITTED, ACCEPTED, WORKING, PARTIAL, FILLED, CANCEL_PENDING, CANCELED, REJECTED, MISSED, TIMED_OUT, UNKNOWN and EXPIRED with explicit legal transitions, including fills that race a cancel request.

The ForwardSessionRunner persists order events in the same SQLite journal as its durable outbox and paper receipts. Intents record CREATED/SUBMITTED; successful receipts record PARTIAL/FILLED/MISSED/REJECTED; a durable outbox exception or restart records UNKNOWN. Session records return the canonical per-order event trace.

Resume reconstructs a missing terminal event only from an already DISPATCHED outbox and its hashed durable receipt. It never turns a PENDING/UNKNOWN key into a fill; receipt-based effect reconciliation or explicit no-effect reconciliation is required first.

Cumulative fill quantity cannot increase outside PARTIAL/FILLED; every increase requires an immutable SHA-256 fill-evidence ID and positive price. UNKNOWN/TIMED_OUT quantities are not counted as known. Complete session close is blocked while an order remains PARTIAL/WORKING/UNKNOWN or otherwise unresolved.

The read-only blotter marks accepted/working/cancel-pending/partial/timeout/unknown orders unresolved and hides fill quantity where outcome is ambiguous. Cash PaperAccount, options ledger and legacy intraday OMS adapters retain separate state models.

items.text: Extend the existing champion/challenger and protected trial infrastructure to require preregistered hypothesis, entry/exit rules, risk budget, target comparison, data cutoff and sample size *before* new paper cohorts are promoted.
Maintain a strategy registry with immutable semantic code/config hashes, features, cost version, active/paused/shadow status, capital permissions and independent desk ownership.
Compare each prospective strategy against cash, relevant instrument benchmark, cost-matched naive strategy and current champion; do not let momentum exposure masquerade as selection alpha.
Add dependent-return statistical methods (session-clustered and block-bootstrap uncertainty), confidence sequences where appropriate, and explicit multiple-testing adjustment across many candidates.

Calibrate forecast probabilities and expected return by market regime, asset, liquidity and confidence strata *only on prior data*, with sample-coverage reports and no adaptive use of protected test results.
Audit change of data vendor, latency class, order size, transaction cost or signal TTL as a material experiment version change; live-paper validation must be repeated when comparability breaks.
Enforce strategy retirement/degradation gates on forward drawdown, negative lower confidence bound, excessive shortfall, stale data and sample integrity; preserve full history of failed trials.

Produce evidence bundles with immutable signals, observed source timestamps, simulated execution receipts, strategy versions, portfolio NAV, trial registration, CI results and attestation state; never infer independent attestation from local hashes.
Build one searchable five-desk `Today` screen with prioritized BUY, SELL, WATCH, NO_TRADE, APPROVAL_NEEDED and EXIT_TRIGGERED messages, market/data freshness and outstanding risk.

Generate two-level alerts: informational opportunity cards and immediate *risk/exit* notices; include as-of time, time-to-expiry, decision deadline, rule version, evidence tier, SL/TP and position impact.
Support human approve/reject/adjust within declared guardrails for the manual paper sleeve; once signal TTL expires, reprice and revalidate instead of using the old approval.

Build an explainable post-market desk report: signals issued, trades eligible, signals missed, filled/exited positions, TP/SL reasons, P&L, fees, skipped opportunities, risk breaches and next-session obligations.
Provide a live health screen with market feed uptime, lag, quote gaps, queue backlog, ledger consistency, pending MF allotment/redemption, option expiry exposure and stale marks.
Enforce idempotent alerts, signals, orders, fills and exit triggers after crash/reconnect; no duplicated order, repeated profit recognition or silent orphan position.
Add a documented operator runbook: market-open preflight, broker-feed failure, kill switch activation, stop-trigger ambiguities, EOD reconciliation, DB backup, restore rehearsal and evidence custody.

Define a daily acceptance gate where the desk cannot report `SESSION_COMPLETE` until all open orders, fills, paper positions, cash, fund units, fees and valuations reconcile or are explicitly flagged unresolved.

Build `index_master` for *all available Nifty indexes* keyed by canonical index identifier, effective-dated name/symbol, index family, provider token, exchange, publication clock and historical coverage. Retain discontinued and renamed series.

Maintain separate `optionable_index_master` from NSE's current listed derivative underlyings and effective-dated contract files: NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, FINNIFTY, MIDCPNIFTY, NIFTYNXT50, NIFTYFPI at the initial snapshot; never assume all indices have options.

Ingest permitted 1-minute historical index prices and live index ticks; build as-of 15-minute OHLC bars; **do not require equity volume or five-level market depth on index packets**, which have a different Kite WebSocket schema.

Subscribe to current option contract ticks, bid/ask, visible quantities, OI, implied-vol inputs, expiry/strike/lot-size metadata, timestamps and source-quality flags; use the *actual tradable option's* depth for fills.

Maintain exchange-date-specific sessions, scheduled bar boundaries, holidays, auctions, expiry cutoffs, provider disconnects and availability calendars; never produce a fictional full bar during a halted/partial session. Confirm provider entitlements and retention limits (**EXTERNAL**).

For index i and a *completed* bar ending at time t, define `r(i,t,15m)=S(i,t+15m)/S(i,t)-1` (and explicit forward 30m/60m/EOD targets). Store actual model-decision and first-executable timestamps; no future-bar joins.

Define 3-class labels UP/DOWN/FLAT using training-period, index-specific price-noise thresholds; version thresholds; compute genuine option cost gates separately. Do not force a trade for a directional lean.

Build point-in-time features from prior 1m/5m/15m/60m returns, volatility, VWAP where meaningful, opening range, realized range, trend slope, overnight gap, time-of-day, session-to-expiry and market regime.

Add cross-index features: Nifty 50 vs Bank/Financial divergence, sector-relative strength, breadth/constituent changes where permissioned, contemporaneous option/futures OI, futures basis, IV skew, realized-versus-implied volatility and flow signals; ensure index constituent survivorship correctness.

Write leak tests: mutate every event after forecast cutoff and assert no features/probabilities change; exclude unreleased revised observations, future index membership, future close/settlement prices or option quotes received after the decision.
Train naive frequency, no-change, price-persistence and volatility/time-of-day baseline classifiers for each index/horizon; benchmark before deep learning.

Train versioned, low-variance tree/logistic models on completed bars; test a shared multi-index model versus six index-specific models and hierarchical sector indexes without leaking information across time.
Generate `P_UP`, `P_DOWN`, `P_FLAT`, expected return in index points/bps, and prediction interval; ensure probabilities sum to 1 and model uncertainty is exposed, not just a confidence score.

Fit probabilities with held-out chronological calibration (e.g. isotonic or temperature calibrator) by market regime and time-of-day only when sufficient samples exist; report Brier/log loss, reliability bins and forecasting coverage.

Use `forecasting/ensemble.py`, `forecasting/calibration.py` and `decisions/forecast_ev.py` where appropriate; compare richer models with simple baselines. Refit only on a declared rolling schedule with frozen versioning and rollback; no hindsight retraining in a purported forward run.

Map each index forecast to CE, PE, defined-risk debit-spread or `NO_TRADE` candidates from *presently listed instruments*; require fresh bid/ask, lot size, displayed depth, expiry and contract eligibility. No synthetic option-chain contracts.

Convert full projected underlying-return/IV/time paths into option-premium outcome distributions with delta, gamma, theta, vega, spreads and realistic execution costs. A `P_UP > 0.60` forecast alone must **not** generate BUY CE.
Rank option candidates by **expected executable net P&L**, downside tails, risk-adjusted expected value and portfolio marginal impact; compare to index/ETF alternatives and `NO_TRADE`.

Publish fully linked **BUY CE / BUY PE / BUY SPREAD** and **SELL/EXIT** intentions including exchange token, expiry, strike, lots, limit-entry band, option-premium SL/TP, underlying invalidation, time stop, trailing/partial exit behavior, quote TTL and maximum planned loss; a trigger does not guarantee fill.

Model expiry-specific restrictions, fast gamma/theta changes, sharp IV collapse, spread widening, large gaps, settlement and multi-leg fill risk; fail closed when margin/settlement/leg synchronization cannot be modeled accurately.

At each valid forecast decision, append an immutable event with `forecast_id`, `index_id`, bar cutoff, data/source timestamps, strategy/config hash, model prediction, option quote snapshot, expected cost and paper eligibility.

Auto-route eligible signals through the **canonical paper OMS**. Capture simulated request, latency, accepted/partial/missed/rejected status, displayed quote/depth, fill quantity/price, fees, and linked position; replay must not masquerade as live forward evidence.

Monitor open paper options **between** 15-minute forecast updates using live market/option ticks for SL, TP, time exit, expiry and invalidation; signals update on a 15m clock, risk management does **not** wait 15m.

Aggregate exposure across NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, FINNIFTY, stocks and index ETFs; enforce underlying/beta/sector correlated risk limits, position caps and daily loss/drawdown kill switches. Prevent duplicated signal orders across refreshes.

Reconcile each index signal to `RESEARCH_ONLY`, `NO_TRADE`, `WATCH`, `PAPER_ELIGIBLE`, `UNFILLED`, `OPEN`, `PARTIALLY_EXITED`, `CLOSED` or `UNPRICED`; no ghost paper profits on missing option quotes or spreads.

Construct global date-wise and session-wise time splits with purging/embargo over overlapping 15m, 30m, 60m labels and cross-index features; use fixed out-of-sample windows and strictly as-of quote availability.

Backtest index direction and option profitability separately. Direction: balanced accuracy, Brier/log loss, calibration by index/regime/clock. Trading: net INR, NAV, expectancy, drawdown, turnover, fill coverage, regret, missed trades and options-specific tail exposure.
Test against no-trade, class-frequency, always-up, momentum, simple volatility and cost-matched CE/PE null strategies; never use 50% directional hit rate as a universal baseline.

Evaluate dependent observations with session-level clustering or block bootstrap, index-correlation adjustment, multiple-testing correction, and separate expiry vs non-expiry days, high-vol vs low-vol, plus each underlying index.

Register this as a **new** strategy/version in existing trial governance; past registered Nifty index VWAP/timing family was `FAIL` (0/9) and minute-bar intraday family was `FAIL`. Do not rewrite these verdicts or claim forward alpha from historical replay. The 2026Q4 protected trial budget is spent; new protected tests require the owner's preregistered governance amendment or 2027Q1 eligibility (**EXTERNAL owner decision/elapsed time**).

Schedule one event at completion of every eligible 15m interval (e.g. bar ending 09:30 → predict 09:30–09:45 IST), using exchange-aware calendars and checks for fully observed bars; keep 30m, 60m, EOD as separately labeled horizons.

Implement WebSocket reconnect, backfill-on-gap, clock skew checks, inference timeouts, circuit breakers, stale-data sentinel, and idempotent resume; emit `UNAVAILABLE` not an invented forecast when critical inputs are absent.

Create an index heatmap/cockpit with per-index UP/DOWN/FLAT, directional probability, expected points, uncertainty, regime, model version, timestamp and last realized score, separating tradable options from research-only indices.

Generate actionable option cards displaying current contract, strike/expiry, CE/PE, price band, SL/TP, modeled risk-reward and **net** expected value, available quantity, confidence evidence and next-update expiry; show real-time paper P&L for approved/autonomous variants.

Publish end-of-day audit: forecast count by index and direction, missing sessions, prediction scores, trades considered, rejected, missed and filled, options premium gains/losses, costs, NAV change, worst trades, forecast-drift alerts and unresolved positions.
Unit-test 15-minute bar closing, feature as-of boundaries, label computation, market open/close, partial bars, no-data, exchange holidays and index instrument-schema differences.
Property-test calibrated probabilities sum to 1, all candidate contracts exist in the effective-dated instrument master, and no paper order can refer to an unlisted/expired/zero-depth option.

Simulate a 15m bullish index forecast with options inflated by IV/theta/spread: expected after-cost option P&L negative => `NO_TRADE`; prevent direction-accuracy optimization from promoting a money-losing option strategy.

Exercise two simultaneous index forecasts with shared exposure, partial entry/exit fills, duplicate tick batches, reconnect, feed lag, exchange halt, expired quotes and overnight gap: no double trade, no early success, correct bounded capital and reconciled P&L.

Complete a real-session *paper-only* rehearsal with six derivative indices plus any research-only index subset, timestamped 15m signals, monitored exits, observed quote-backed paper fills and auditable separate forecast/portfolio scorecards. Require sufficient future independent evidence before calling this an edge; never auto-enable physical orders.

Archive the user-supplied 2025-08-22 09:30 XAUUSD M1 Four-Node rules verbatim in a versioned specification with source hash and no silent edits. **Acceptance:** Immutable original specification and checksum are committed.

Create `FourNode_XAU_Original_v1` as non-executable research reference and `FourNode_India_v1` as separately versioned, initially paper-only implementation. **Acceptance:** Both have independent configuration and provenance.

Flag BUY exception text (“below N2”) as contradictory to normal BUY (“above N2”); require explicit owner-confirmed interpretation before executable signals. **Acceptance:** Ambiguous BUY variant fails closed.

Flag BUY N3 <= 20C midpoint and SELL N3 <= 20C midpoint symmetry/asymmetry as unresolved; preserve both alternative hypotheses without assuming correction. **Acceptance:** Variants have named rules and are never merged in one trial.
Flag N2 sell <= 20C Low, N2 buy <= 20C High, and original “20H High” typo; confirm intended comparator, reference bar and inclusive equality. **Acceptance:** Tests show behavior on boundary cases.

Define N4 precisely (fourth confirmed fractal pivot versus breakout candle), its confirmation time, wick test and exit trigger; block until specified. **Acceptance:** No fabricated N4 can trigger entry/exit.

Specify “significant candle” rigorously: equal upper/lower wick tolerance, both wicks > body or combined wick > body, doji handling, and when checked. **Acceptance:** Explicit fixtures distinguish competing interpretations.

Define Fibonacci anchors, timezone/session boundaries, daily reset, whether levels come from previous completed day, and levels outside 0–100%; never use current-day final high/low. **Acceptance:** Prior-day-only levels reproduce without lookahead.

Implement configurable Wilder-style SMMA(20) separately for Low, Close and High as `20C`; specify initialization, warm-up, missing-bar and session reset policies. **Acceptance:** Golden OHLC fixtures reproduce all three bands.

Implement SMMA(8), SMMA(50), SMMA(100), SMMA(200) on Close with explicit warm-up and consistent alignment; do not silently replace SMMA with EMA/SMA. **Acceptance:** Numerical parity tests against independent reference calculations.

Implement the complete original daily Fibonacci ratio set: -323.4, -200, -161.8, -141.4, -100, -76.4, -61.8, -41.4, -27, -12.8, 0, 11.4, 23.6, 38.2, 50, 61.8, 76.4, 88.6, 100, 112.8, 127, 141.4, 161.8, 176.4, 200, 261.8, 423.6. **Acceptance:** Levels and anchor timestamps are versioned and tested.

Build configurable fractal detector with left/right confirmation windows, plateau/tie policy, minimum swing size and pivot-high/pivot-low alternation. **Acceptance:** Future bars do not alter previously emitted confirmed node events.
Store node `pivot_at` separately from `confirmed_at`, `observable_at`, price, side, parent chain and source bar IDs. **Acceptance:** No node is eligible before `observable_at`.
Implement N1→N2→N3→N4 zigzag state machine, reset/invalidation rules, expiry, same-bar conflict handling and idempotent event replay. **Acceptance:** Deterministic online/replay parity.

Enforce exactly three permanently confirmed trending fractal nodes before evaluating breakout through N2 on a completed M1 candle. **Acceptance:** No pivot discovered from future bars is traded retroactively.

Define buy/sell direction, N1-to-20C High/Low, N3-to-20C Mid, N2-to-20C limits and exception logic as explicit independent predicates with reason codes. **Acceptance:** Every rejected/eligible setup lists passed/failed predicates.

Implement close-confirmed N2 breakout with strictly later actionable order timestamp; choose next available quote/bar execution rather than filling at a known completed close. **Acceptance:** No signal uses same-bar hindsight fill.

Implement D1=|N2−N3| and D2=|entry−N2| with inclusive/exclusive boundaries configurable; original 15/10 pip limits are preserved only for XAU baseline. **Acceptance:** Threshold boundary fixtures pass.

Enforce minimum distance to daily Fibonacci levels and SMMA50/100/200, accounting for direction, support/resistance geometry and original 20-pip baseline. **Acceptance:** Barriers ahead and behind entry are distinguished.

Implement broker spread-aware initial stop beyond N3 (SELL above, BUY below) and reject trades with excessive initial risk. **Acceptance:** Stops obey exchange tick rounding and no invalid-side orders.

Implement original 20-pip TP and max 15-pip stop as XAU-specific configurable baseline, with separate ATR/tick/percent alternatives for Indian assets. **Acceptance:** No assumption that XAU pip == Indian tick.

Implement the original trailing rule: at +10 pips remove fixed TP and move SL to entry+5 pips for long / entry−5 pips for short; ratchet at each additional +5 pip favorable move. **Acceptance:** State-machine tests cover every threshold and never loosen stops.

Clarify whether the 10-pip activation and 5-pip SL offset are measured on bid/ask executable prices, and prevent spread-induced false trigger or impossible fills. **Acceptance:** Long/short spread tests pass.

Implement N4 wick <5 pip filter and significant-candle early exit as separate, precisely timestamped controls, pending source ambiguity resolution. **Acceptance:** Unknown N4 or candle definition returns BLOCKED.

Create per-instrument conversion config for tick size, ATR normalization, spread, expected slippage, trading hours, contract multiplier and corporate action adjustment. **Acceptance:** Same rule runs on Nifty, Bank Nifty, stocks and ETFs with correct units.

Replace forex balance multiplier X with capital-at-risk sizing; retain X=1→0.01 lots per $100 only as original forex demonstration, never apply it to Indian options. **Acceptance:** Risk budget and lot constraints cannot be exceeded.

Prioritize underlying Nifty/Bank Nifty and liquid equities/ETFs for directional tests; maintain symbol-specific data-quality and tradability checks. **Acceptance:** No unsupported instrument or imaginary contract receives a trade.

Bridge underlying fractal BUY/SELL signal into index options CE/PE candidate generation without assuming an underlying move implies positive option P&L. **Acceptance:** Underlying signal and option decision are separate auditable records.
Evaluate option expiry, strike, observed bid/ask, IV, Greeks, time decay, liquidity and depth for each CE/PE candidate at signal time. **Acceptance:** Stale/unavailable option quotes cause NO_TRADE.

Map underlying invalidation and exit conditions to option-premium SL/TP, max premium risk, time stop and tick-driven exit monitoring; avoid copying index points into option premium ticks. **Acceptance:** Options paper exits use actual quote-backed premium and costs.

Implement separate futures and ETF execution adapters with correct contract sizing, margin/settlement, liquidity and fee models; paper-only by default. **Acceptance:** Cross-asset unit and ledger tests pass.

Integrate as an optional signal source into the 15-minute Nifty forecasting desk while keeping native M1 pattern clock and independent tick-driven risk clock. **Acceptance:** No 15-minute delay for a one-minute signal or protective exit.

Reuse `patterns/pivots.py`, `patterns/streaming.py`, `kernel/indicators.py`, `ingest/kite_minute.py`, `paper/intraday_runner.py` and `paper/options_runner.py` after interface audit; avoid duplicate frameworks. **Acceptance:** Architecture mapping documents reuse versus gaps.

Build point-in-time replay with original bar timestamps, historical instrument eligibility, warm-up and confirmed-pivot latency; disallow revised ZigZag history as trading evidence. **Acceptance:** Streaming and historical signals match when fed identical observations.
Test the unmodified XAU baseline only on suitable XAU data if legally available; label unsupported or unavailable input honestly. **Acceptance:** No false XAU validation claim.

Pre-register India variants, instrument universe, parameter bounds, entry/exit rules, cost model and statistical gates before evaluation; respect protected trial budgets. **Acceptance:** Immutable registration and trial-family accounting.
Run walk-forward tests across disjoint time windows and market regimes; purge/embargo overlapping targets and group by trading day. **Acceptance:** No time leakage; report independent sample counts.
Benchmark against simple N2 breakout, opening-range breakout, random-entry matched-exposure, and no-trade baselines. **Acceptance:** Report incremental net alpha and uncertainty.

Use realistic spread, latency, commissions, taxes, price gaps, option premium decay and conservative same-bar SL/TP ordering. **Acceptance:** All trades reconcile to quote-backed or explicitly bounded execution.

Perform parameter stability and multiple-testing corrections across fractal widths, moving-average variants, ATR scaling, Fibonacci filters and asset families. **Acceptance:** No cherry-picked winner promoted without adjustment.

Track funnel: raw pivots → confirmed patterns → qualified setups → buy/sell intents → observed paper fills → closing events → net P&L, including rejects and expirations. **Acceptance:** Every count reconciles to event IDs.

Add per-trade evidence: N1–N4 coordinates and confirmation times, 20C bands, SMMA8/50/100/200, Fibonacci barriers, D1/D2, spread, SL/TP and exit reason. **Acceptance:** Human-readable trace and machine-verifiable event record.

Run adversarial tests for repainting, missed candles, reconnect, holiday rollover, stale bid/ask, bid/ask inversion, ambiguous same-bar fills, crashes and duplicate signals. **Acceptance:** Fail closed, deterministic recovery and zero accidental broker orders.

Promote only after independent prospective paper sessions show stable positive net risk-adjusted results beyond costs and appropriately corrected baselines; otherwise keep research-only. **Acceptance:** No guarantee of profitability; all failed outcomes preserved.
Capture SHA, branch, tree hash, working-tree state, Python/OS, lockfile hash, datasource entitlements, current date and every scheduled task's checkout path; fail on an unrecorded mismatch.
Snapshot all open PRs and their bases, branch ancestry, CI results and protected research artifacts; do not silently treat unmerged code as production capability.
Copy the 405 v1.4 tasks into a read-only traceability index; label each code path DONE/PARTIAL/FOOTHOLD/NOT_STARTED/EXTERNAL and include tests and concrete SHA.
Reconcile the historical trial count (13 in earlier files versus 14 in the newer survey); let immutable ledger bytes determine the truth, and annotate contradictions instead of rewriting history.
Freeze every research outcome, historical score and post-hoc rescore with original run identity, cost assumptions, train/validation/test periods and exposure.
Record the original strategy families, scanned indicators, rule permutations, failed candidates and the total research look budget for future multiple-testing control.
Build a capability provenance manifest separating main, PR #34, #36/#37/#38, #39 and #40; include each source's actual commit SHA and dependency graph.
Mark every existing P&L value as historical, historical-paper, local prospective, or independently auditable forward evidence, never a generic `profit` boolean.
Define the five desks and their permissible actions: equities/intraday/swing, ETFs, long or defined-risk options, and NAV-based mutual funds; never force intraday execution on mutual funds.
Declare the business objective: positive expected *and realized prospective* risk-adjusted net value after full costs, not daily positive P&L or every-signal trade frequency.
Create a signed/hashable execution charter with owner capital budget, hard loss limits, execution mode, and permitted instruments; the model must not self-approve real cash.
Emit a machine-readable `profit_readiness.json` listing current `RED/AMBER/GREEN` gates and links to exact evidence; reject hand-edited status percentages.
Establish a canonical merge sequence by graph-based dependency audit; PR #37 precedes #36, and #38 depends on #36 unless deliberately rebased with a test-backed change log.
Compare the forward-edge runner implementation in `main` versus PR #40; produce a per-public-contract `KEEP/MERGE/REIMPLEMENT/REJECT` reconciliation table.
Explicitly preserve both forward-edge F17 instrument/data gates and F13 capability renderer if needed; PR #40 documents their omission and they must not vanish unnoticed.
Reconcile trial governance: retain mandatory experiment charter, cohort registry, immutable trials and owner-authorized quarter budget when reconciling PR #40's branch trial policy.
Merge equivalent order/cash reconciliation implementations into one canonical API; prohibit two simultaneous ledgers from both claiming ownership of capital.
Re-run all historical protected-baseline SHA checks after every merge, including LF/CRLF normalization rules with canonical serialization tests.
Resolve source inventory snapshot failure in PR #40 without loosening assertions; create deterministic cross-platform inventory generation.
Investigate failed main CI runs and distinguish runner/billing failures from actual test failures using workflow job evidence; document root causes rather than assuming either.
Eliminate duplicate chart-pattern CI steps; maintain an explicit `ruff`, `mypy`, migration, invariant, unit, integration, coverage, dependency-audit matrix.
Enforce branch protection, required checks, review and CODEOWNERS where enabled; do not present a local simulated check as a hosted required check.
Add merger integration fixtures exercising all five desks, existing zoos, closed trade reconciliation, event custody, and negative physical-order probes.
Resolve effective scheduled checkout paths: production runner must report exact source SHA at startup and refuse running stale or unreviewed branch content.
Add a release provenance manifest containing source SHA, test artifact hashes, changelog, strategy-rule hashes and data-rights posture.
Add deterministic replay-before-release and rollback rehearsal; restore the prior known-good release if any net-P&L or ledger consistency invariant fails.
Require one clean release candidate from a fresh clone with **no developer-specific data paths**; report missing external prerequisites without hiding failed test coverage.
Keep live broker order routing physically disabled at build, config, CLI, API and integration-test layers throughout the entire profitability program.

Create data-use matrix by provider/product: private research, retained history, real-time algorithmic use, derivatives depth, synthetic/replay, paper simulation, redistribution and permitted retention.
Keep Kite live-quote paper simulation disabled or isolated until written permission resolves the documented virtual/mock-trading ambiguity; use only expressly permitted sources and modes meanwhile.
Log source contract, evidence of approval and expiry for every entitlement; failed or expired entitlements automatically halt that datasource.
Build a source-aware instrument master with time-varying ISIN, futures/options contract token, strike, right, lot, tick, expiry, adjustments and source timestamp.
Reconcile 15-minute index symbols to actually optionable underlyings and currently listed contracts; unavailable contract means `NO_OPTION_TRADE`, never a generated strike.
Deduplicate quote and candle records by instrument, event ID, venue, source clock and payload hash; preserve corrections and late arrivals instead of silent overwrite.
Implement `exchange_ts`, `received_ts`, `available_at`, `published_at`, and `computed_at` across all relevant feeds; only available data reaches a signal.
Detect partial candle, missing minute, wrong interval anchor, session-open gap, stale tick, nonmonotonic timestamp, crossed market and out-of-sequence event.
Model survivorship: delisted/suspended stocks, expired option tokens, historical scheme closures, futures contract roll and ETF listing changes remain in past universes.
Audit price-return versus total-return fields; verify dividends, splits, rights, bonus and corporate actions do not create false momentum or false reversal alpha.
Probe suspected ex-dividend artifacts in H056/H068 without treating a repaired dataset as a valid new holdout; log changed labels and original trial verdicts.
Build data quality reports by instrument/day: coverage, late tick rate, inconsistent OHLC, bid/ask depth validity, quote age and strike selection error.
Add deterministic, low-cost synthetic fixture and delayed/replay feed modes for engineering tests; visually and cryptographically distinguish fixture rows from true market observations.
Use a timezone-aware NSE calendar, effective-dated expiry and settlement tables, session halts, special sessions and instrument-specific cutoffs.
Prove no look-ahead by mutating all source rows published after the decision and requiring byte-identical features and intended orders.
Introduce `DATA_UNUSABLE` and fail-closed trade rejection for a missing source or quality violation; no forward-fill that pretends a quote was tradable.
Build one deterministic event loop for session open, completed bars, quotes, corporate actions, margin changes, decisions, protective exits and closeout.
Separate forecasting frequency (e.g., every completed 15-minute index bar) from continuous exit evaluation; never wait 15 minutes to check a protective exit.
Add independent heartbeats for quote feed, bars, strategy process, clock synchronization, ledger writes and position monitor; each reports last-good event.
Prevent partial 15-minute or 1-minute candles from being marked complete; align to 09:15 IST exchange session start, not local wall-clock bucket boundaries.
Build rate-limit-aware batching with token-bucket quotas, backpressure, subscriptions and request jitter; never infer full market coverage from one successful option-chain quote call.
Ensure each instrument has an explicit required data profile (index level-only versus option bid/ask/depth versus MF NAV); reject missing execution data.
Restore and verify monthly rebalance processing for H003/H005/P3 after the PR #39 missing-return exception; one bad holding cannot freeze the whole desk.
Detect skipped scheduled runs and stale monthly books using intended-versus-actual rebalance hash comparisons; alert with exact missing signal date.
Create data/event offsets and checkpointing so a restart resumes without duplicate signals, fills or allocations.
Time every stage: event receipt, feature computation, model inference, risk evaluation, intended order, simulated arrival and ledger record.
Tag each decision with `as_of`, `first_executable_after`, `expires_at`, last-good-quote-age and chosen execution method.
Implement explicit `PAUSED`, `DEGRADED`, `RECOVERING`, `HALTED` states; failed data freshness cannot silently continue opening trades.
Build bounded circuit-breaker recovery with exponential retry, feed priority and log deduplication; all open-position state remains durable.
Record overnight carry and option expiry handling separately from intraday forced flatten; disallow trading after exchange cutoff.
Keep provider calls read-only in paper mode and prove via monkeypatching/denying all broker write endpoints.
Validate 20 consecutive local replay sessions with injected missing minutes, restarts, rate limits and market pauses; inspect event ordering and output consistency.
Enumerate existing OMS, paper books, legacy intraday runner, option spread runner and forward-edge pipeline; document one authoritative account/position ownership contract.
Unify buy/close/sell-short/buy-to-cover, options premium and spreads, ETF shares, corporate cash actions and mutual-fund NAV-order events without losing asset-specific semantics.
Build immutable entry, fill, partial fill, amend, stop policy, stop trigger, target trigger, cancel, expire and exit events; link to strategy and decision hashes.
Add atomic reservations for cash, margin, risk capital, options buying power, instrument quantity, pending settlement and sellable inventory.
Validate every transition before mutation; reject negative reserved cash, oversold quantity, ghost lots, inverted option legs and duplicate fill identifiers.
Pair **all** open positions with an exit policy and a crash-resumable monitor; require auditable exceptions for product types like NAV-based mutual funds.
Reconcile the 51 reported legacy intraday trades lacking recorded exits; classify independently as `OPEN_UNKNOWN`, `LEDGER_INCOMPLETE`, or confirmed close, never backfill invented fill prices.
Treat PR #39's stale last-good quote close as a **valuation estimate** and unresolved liquidation, not an observed executable `SELL` fill; release P&L only when exit evidence exists.
Implement stop-market and stop-limit paper semantics with bid/ask, gap-through-stop, partial fill, queue/latency and no-liquidity cases; SL is a trigger, not a guaranteed price.
Implement mutually exclusive stop/target cancellation and replay-safe OCO simulation; handle race conditions when a fill arrives after cancellation.

Declare market data ingestion unavailable during outages, holidays or unauthorized periods; expose `NO_DATA` and stop policy decisions.
Provide training/validation/test data manifests with as-of cutoffs, raw file hashes, transforms and explicit unavailable source periods.
Prevent normalization, universe filtering and feature selection from fitting on validation/test periods.
Block paper simulation using broker live data where provider terms prohibit it until written interpretation or a permitted source is obtained.

Add price-return, volatility, range, trend, volume participation, gap, session VWAP, breadth and liquidity as separate causal feature families.

Keep raw, adjusted and total-return price series separated; enforce dividend and split correctness by arithmetic reconciliation.
Add `FeatureSnapshot` with observation/availability timestamp, feature version, source hashes and missingness masks.
Guard against stale indicator values, forward-filled expired contracts and all market-close-to-open boundary leakage.
Create streaming/offline parity fixtures: same market event prefix must produce same feature values in replay and forward processing.
Apply schema migrations with checksummed transformations and automatic feature lineage invalidation when raw source corrections arrive.
Measure feature stability by date, instrument, regime and provider; surface feature drift before automatic retraining.
Detect proxy leakage (index weights inferred from revised constituents, event timestamps after publication, synthetic corporate-action adjustment).
Store exclusion reasons and instrument eligibility at each timestamp so the learner can model genuine no-trade opportunities.
Make feature computation idempotent and deterministic under out-of-order, duplicate and corrected input events.
Benchmark feature inference latency and memory on realistic multi-index and liquid-stock universes.
Force each learned policy to emit all feature IDs and their availability proof in its decision manifest.
Implement `ResearchAgent`, `HypothesisGenerator`, `ExperimentExecutor`, `Evaluator`, `PolicyRegistry`, `RiskGovernor`, `PaperOperator`, `Auditor` interfaces.
Use one event-sourced learning state machine: `HYPOTHESIS → REGISTERED → TRAINED → OOS_TESTED → SHADOW → FORWARD_CANDIDATE → REVIEWED → RETIRED`.
Keep immutable trial identity over family, instrument universe, horizon, dataset version, feature set, action space, reward, code SHA and cost model.
Separate learning-state writes from portfolio-state writes; research agents must not change cash, fills, ledger balances or release policy.
Model all strategy recommendations as `PROPOSE`, `WATCH`, `NO_TRADE`, `EXIT_PROPOSAL`; ownership gates decide eligibility.
Create reason-coded rejection paths for insufficient sample, leakage, stale data, missing rights, excessive cost and unsafe action.
Expose `PolicyDecision` with probabilities, expected net excess, uncertainty, capacity, risk budget, provenance and available-at clock.
Add freeze windows: retraining cannot mutate currently deployed policy weights, state definitions or reward functions during a session.
Declare learning budgets: CPU/GPU/time/disk/trial counts; budget exhaustion must stop research automatically.
Build human-only permission checks for changing statistical thresholds, capital caps, strategy families, broker flags or protected holdouts.
Create structured machine-readable experiment reports and human-readable economic rationale, with no success claims from test count.
Implement data/reward/protocol contracts as schemas with Pydantic or pure typed validators, pinned by hashes.
Declare deterministic simulation mode and probabilistic training mode with seed registers and reproducibility reports.
Integrate with existing `forward_edge/` claim tiers and ADRs via adapters; no parallel, less strict promotion path.
Implement familywise lineage: descendants share parent discovery-trial budget and cannot reset failure history by renaming.
Include policy abstention and market-close actions in every decision API; forbid forced trades.
Develop kill-switch and audited manual intervention paths that work even if all learning services are unavailable.
Define outcome statuses `FAIL`, `NO_EDGE`, `CANDIDATE`, `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE`, `PAPER_CONFIRMED`, never fabricate evidence.
Model the task as a partially observable sequential decision process, not a fully known future price trajectory.
Define state `s_t = (point-in-time market features, holdings, cash, drawdown, orders, remaining time, data health, model uncertainty)`.
Define policy action as abstract desired position/option intent; the risk governor projects it into a feasible trade or NO_TRADE.
Create configurable episode boundaries by instrument/session/month/expiry; no accidental carry across account restarts.
